features.name: upi_txn_frequency
features.label: Digital transaction frequency (per month)
features.description: How often the person transacts digitally (UPI/wallet) per month.

features.name: upi_txn_regularity
features.label: Transaction regularity score (0-100)
features.description: How consistent transaction timing/amounts are, month to month.

features.name: avg_monthly_inflow
features.label: Average monthly digital inflow (INR)
features.description: Average money received digitally per month (proxy for earnings).

features.name: recharge_regularity
features.label: Mobile recharge regularity (0-100)
features.description: Consistency of prepaid mobile recharges — a known proxy for stable routine.

features.name: utility_payment_timeliness
features.label: Utility bill payment timeliness (%)
features.description: Percent of electricity/water/gas bills paid on or before due date.

features.name: savings_growth_6m
features.label: Savings/wallet balance growth over 6 months (%)
features.description: Trend in digital wallet or savings balance over the last 6 months.

features.name: peer_vouches
features.label: Verified peer/community vouches (0-5)
features.description: Number of verified vouches from community members or trade association.

features.name: business_vintage_months
features.label: Business/work vintage (months)
features.description: How long the person has been doing this work or running this business.

features.name: geo_stability
features.label: Location stability score (0-100)
features.description: How stable the person's operating location / service area is over time.

features.name: digital_footprint_diversity
features.label: Digital footprint diversity (0-100)
features.description: Diversity of everyday app usage (marketplace, delivery, payments, etc.).
